svg.title: Conditional expectation and where the problem is hard
svg.desc: Left, the implied clean prediction against the noisy value at three noise levels. Right, the advantage of the optimal predictor over the best affine one, peaking at intermediate noise.
svg.text: The optimal prediction averages over what it cannot see
how much the network has to know
Both curves in the right panel are scaled to their own peak; only their shapes are being compared.
